sxD00: Drop zone loop. InsertionCinematic_Loop turns into it; play it to skip ahead.
sxD01: Insertion one-shot that turns into the drop zone loop after a few seconds.
sxD02: One-shot for jumping out at insertion.
sxD04: One-shot, played when you are in the last two squads.
sxD05: Loop for being eliminated before the end of the round.
sxD06: Loop for losing at the end of the round in third place or worse.
sxD07: Loop for finishing the round in second place.
sxD08: Pauses whatever BR music is playing.
sxD13: Plays when the lobby fills. Set BRGauntlet_LobbyTimerRemaining before playing it.
sxD14: Quiet loop while waiting for players in the lobby.
sxD15: Lobby countdown, 10 to 0, used by BRGauntlet_LobbyFilled. Set it once, then play that.
sxD16: Quiet, ambient loop, played while players are deploying.
sxD17: End-of-match loop. Core_IsWinning and Core_Sector pick the version.
sxD18: One-shot track for the start of the last phase.
sxD19: Quiet, suspenseful loop for overtime, e.g. capturing a point in overtime.
sxD20: Quiet, ambient loop for the pause menu.
sxD21: One-shot for the start of a phase. Core_IsWinning and Core_Sector pick the version.
sxD22: One-shot for the end of a phase. Core_IsWinning and Core_Sector pick the version.
sxD25: Sting played at the end of a match when you rank up.
sxD26: 0 = losing, 1 = winning. Picks the version of PhaseBegin, PhaseEnded and EndOfRound.
sxD27: Above 0, end-of-phase tension music starts at once. Each whole number adds a layer.
sxD28: 0 = no sectors (Conquest). 1 to 3 = that sector's music (Breakthrough).
sxD29: Above 0, end-of-round tension music starts at once. Each whole number adds a layer.
sxD31: Loop for losing the final mission.
sxD32: Loop for losing any mission except the final one.
sxD33: One-shot for the final mission briefing.
sxD34: One-shot for the first mission briefing.
sxD35: One-shot for the third mission briefing.
sxD36: One-shot for the second mission briefing.
sxD37: Pauses whatever Gauntlet music is playing.
sxD38: Loop for qualifying. Play Qualified_Outro next for a smooth ending.
sxD39: One-shot outro. Follows Qualified_Loop smoothly, or plays on its own.
sxD42: Long urgency one-shot for the final mission, 35 seconds.
sxD44: Empties the queue. The only way to remove queued tracks.
sxD45: Skips to the next queued track.
sxD46: Plays the queued tracks on the selected channel. An empty queue plays nothing.
sxD47: Which region's radio station. Only used on channel 4.
sxD48: Station: 0 Hip Hop, 1 Rock, 2 BF Themes, 3 Reggaeton, 4 by biome, 5 Classical, 6 Pop.
sxD49: 1 = play the next queued track when one ends. 0 = stop after each track.
sxD50: 1 = start the queue over after the last track. 0 = stop at the end.
sxD51: Track to add, from 0 up to the station's last (below). QUEUE TRACK adds it, then moves on.
sxN202: Adds the track number to the queue.
sxN215: ME: only you. EVERYONE: all players.
sxN222: PLAY re-sends the package params and VOLUME before the event, so what you hear matches the numbers.
sxN236: The code takes a few seconds to draw. If your phone does not pick it up, move closer or turn up the screen brightness.
sxN237: The last call sent. The game cannot report what is playing.
sxN242: Your phone shows your favourites as text. Copy it into a note or a message.
sxS19: No favourites yet. Use + on a row.
sxS56: tap a prefix, then refine on ABC
sxS57: Type with the on-screen keyboard. It searches names across every group. DONE closes the keyboard, CLEAR empties it.
sxS58: MENU CLOSED - aim (right mouse) to reopen - fire (left mouse) to spawn what is armed
sxS59: SEARCH or pick an effect, set SCALE, then SELECT. The menu closes and the gadget arms it.
sxS60: Fire to place it at your aim point. Aim reopens the menu to change it, undo, or delete all.
sxS61: SEARCH or pick a sound, set AMPLITUDE and RANGE, then SELECT. The menu closes and the gadget arms it.
sxS62: Auditions straight away. Fire to place it at your aim point, or aim to reopen the menu.
sxS63: Aim to open the menu, pick a sound or effect, press SELECT, then fire
sxS77: Changes are sent live while the track plays. PLAY sends them all first.
sxS78: No params in this package besides VOLUME.
sxS79: Pick a package and a track, set the params, then PLAY. PLAY loads the package first when needed (about 5 s).
sxS80: Pick a channel and a track number, QUEUE TRACK it, then PLAY. The first QUEUE TRACK loads the radio (about 5 s).
sxS83: Queue tracks first. PLAY plays the queue, NEXT TRACK skips within it, CLEAR QUEUE empties it.
sxS84: The queue holds tracks from another station. CLEAR QUEUE, then queue tracks here.
sxS85: QUEUE: empty. Pick a track number, then press QUEUE TRACK.
